name: Three Footed Crow Summon Scroll
description:
Bird of a legend, also said to be the messenger of the sun, Three Footed Crow lives at the sun eating the flame of the sun.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules. The summon item is reusable; this pet has no rental expiry. Recall and resummon do not consume it.
